newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA SHARES END UP, OFFICIAL LIST LEADS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA SHARES END UP, OFFICIAL LIST LEADS.

text.p: Lithuanian official list companies on Monday led the market higher by the close, bringing cautious optimism for more gains this week, dealers said.
"The major shares on the official list...activated the whole market today," Arvydas Jacikevichius, a broker with Suprema brokerage, told Reuters.
The official list, which tracks the bourse's five blue chips, rose to 115.45 points, up 19.40 points, while the wider group A index advanced by 14.19 points to 1875.48 points.
Turnover on the central market was 1.557 million litas while business of 1.89 million litas was registered in block trades.
"I would say that the trend for a slow rise of the official list will carry on this week as price changes in major stocks were no higher than two to five percent," Jacikevichius added.
Hermis Bank rose to 267 from 265 litas on turnover of 981,000 litas while Vilniaus Bank advanced to 305.10 litas from 300 on turnover of 50,000 litas.
Vilniaus Bank also registered a deal of 421,000 litas in block trade pricse ranging between 305 and 300 litas.
Birzhu Dairy showed the biggest growth of 7.22 percent and rose titas from 9.0 on turnover of 68,000 litas. The price of Birzhu has stayed steady at around nine litas for the past few months.
"The company started operation of its new production line bottling milk into plastic bottles which has become very popular with consumers and boosted the firm's sales in July," Jacikevichius said.
